mapper.select: select user_id, type, count(role_id) as count from rtks_situation_log inner join rtks_role on rtks_situation_log.role_id = rtks_role.resource_id group by user_id, type
select * from rtks_situation_log order by id desc limit 100;

select a.resource_id as level_id, a.name as level_name, c.resource_id as role_id, c.name as role_name from rtks_level a inner join rtks_level b on a.resource_id = b.parent left join rtks_role c on b.resource_id = c.level_id where a.parent = #{masterId} order by a.id
select create_time from rtks_situation_log order by id limit 1
